esim_sim_notes.value: Tourist registration (e-Mehmon) is required within 3 business days; hotels handle this automatically, keep the paper slips until border departure. Ucell, Beeline, and Mobiuz offer tourist eSIMs.

dos.title: Respect bread (Non)
dos.description: Bread is sacred in Uzbek culture; never place flatbread (lepyoshka/non) upside down or throw it away.

dos.title: Keep hotel registration slips (e-Mehmon)
dos.description: Hotels will issue small registration coupons; keep all of them safely in your passport until exit customs.

dos.title: Dress modestly at historical madrassas and mosques
dos.description: Cover shoulders and knees when visiting working mosques and active shrines in Samarkand and Bukhara.

donts.title: Don't discard registration receipts
donts.description: Border guards may ask for your hotel registration slips; losing them can result in administrative delays.

donts.title: Don't photograph security infrastructure
donts.description: Avoid photographing military checkpoints, border zones, or airport control areas without explicit clearance.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10% is customary in modern Tashkent restaurants; traditional chaikhanas often include a 10-15% service charge.
